name: Rebecca Ira
source:
She migrated from the Diamond Kingdom and now runs a clothing store in Central Plaza. She has a strong passion for designing and making clothes and would often head to the farm to pick the materials herself.

She used to be an opera singer and still sometimes sings in front of her shop. She fell in love with a soldier in the Volcano Kingdom and they settled there together, but he never returned after heading to the forest.

[Edited from in-game bio]
